item.name: Show Temporary Access for Current User

variable.description: (Required) The username of the user for which to show a temporary access.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`
(Required) The unique identifier of the temporary access to show.</br>**Example:** `wrm4yyygma4dga6zouiqcaknv4`

request.description: Shows a temporary access for the current user.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

item.name: Revoke Temporary Access for Current User

variable.description: (Required) The username of the user for which to revoke a temporary access.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`
(Required) The unique identifier of the temporary access to revoke.</br>**Example:** `0378a782-ca90-11e9-a32f-2a2ae2dbcce4`

request.description: Revokes temporary access for a user to an organization.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

request.description: Lists the expired and revoked temporary accesses for the current user.

variable.description:

**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`
(Required) The unique identifier of the temporary access to show.</br>**Example:** `wrm4yyygma4dga6zouiqcaknv4`

request.description:
Shows a temporary access in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"TEMPORARY_ACCESS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
